meta.name: lcx-contribute-bug-fix
meta.description: Contribute a verified bug fix for LazyCodex, lazycodex-ai, omo-codex, bundled Codex skills, or upstream Codex CLI bugs. Opens a fork PR only for upstream openai/codex; LazyCodex-owned defects become a verified-fix issue on code-yeongyu/lazycodex (never a PR — that repo is a generated distribution mirror). Use when the user asks to fix a bug, contribute a bug fix, contribute to fix bug, open a PR for a bug, or debug and PR a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 LazyCodex 或 Codex 项目提交经过验证的缺陷修复
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在使用 LazyCodex 或 Codex 并想贡献修复
copy.tagline_en: Submit a verified bug fix for LazyCodex or Codex projects
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use LazyCodex or Codex and want to contribute a fix

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会调试并修复 LazyCodex 或 Codex 的 bug：在临时工作区复现、写失败测试、做最小修复、验证后交付——对上游 openai/codex 发 PR，对 LazyCodex 仓库只发带补丁的 issue（不开 PR），全程附日志证据。
howto.when: 当用户要求修复 bug、为 bug 开 PR，或要求为 LazyCodex/Codex 缺陷贡献修复时触发。

say.text: 帮我修复 LazyCodex 安装时的这个 bug 并提交修复。
say.note: Claude 会先复现，再交付带补丁的 issue。

say.text: 为这个 Codex CLI 的崩溃缺陷提一个 PR。
say.note: Claude 会从 fork 创建 PR，附日志。

say.text: 调试 omo-codex 的市场同步问题，给我验证过的补丁。
say.note: Claude 会生成含 diff 的 issue。

howto.what_en: Claude will debug and fix LazyCodex/Codex bugs: reproduce, failing test, minimal fix, verify, then deliver a fork PR for openai/codex or a patch issue for LazyCodex repos (never a PR), all with logs.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks to fix a bug, open a PR for a bug, or contribute a fix for a LazyCodex/Codex defect.

say_en.text: Fix this LazyCodex installation bug and submit the fix.
say_en.note: Claude will reproduce, patch, and deliver a verified-fix issue.

say_en.text: Open a PR for this Codex CLI crash.
say_en.note: Claude will create a fork PR with logs.

say_en.text: Debug the omo-codex marketplace sync issue and give me a verified patch.
say_en.note: Claude will produce an issue with an embedded diff.
